quarterly_data.quarter: Emerson press release: Emerson's Integrated Automation Portfolio Fast-Tracks (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Emerson presents the DeltaV Automation Platform for Data Centers, an automation portfolio designed for AI-scale data centers: a unified automation system for the monitoring and control of data center critical infrastructure that brings the thermal, mechanical and electrical sub-systems under one scalable architecture, coordinating them for real-time response to power and cooling load changes. It comprises the DeltaV distributed control system (DCS) and DeltaV programmable logic controllers (PLCs) that connect to the DCS, both with embedded context-specific AI to accelerate engineering workflows, provide advanced process control and let data centers integrate AI optimization models. Emerson says decoupling hardware and software allows parallel execution and standardized equipment-level and facility-wide control, improving project schedules, and that the platform replaces point solutions to bring gigawatt-scale facilities online faster (company claims; the release names no customer, availability date or figure).
